advisories.RUSTSEC-2021-0035: Fixed in quinn 0.7 long before noq forked; the fork's history has the change.
advisories.RUSTSEC-2023-0063: Fixed by quinn f81c2fafa, which is in the fork's history.
advisories.RUSTSEC-2024-0373: Fixed by quinn e01609cc, which is in the fork's history.
advisories.RUSTSEC-2026-0037: Not affected: the fork's transport parameter parser returns errors where quinn unwrapped.
advisories.RUSTSEC-2026-0185: Not affected: reassembly backing and metadata are charged to the fork's per-connection receive budget, and each coalesced packet gets its own allocation, by the fork commit "Copy coalesced packets apart".
advisories.RUSTSEC-2026-0338: Not affected: the fork's ArrayRangeSet has no replace, and the server reads streams in order.
advisories.RUSTSEC-2026-0339: Fixed upstream in noq 1.4.0 (78a4b2eed); the fork queues each retired ID through its charged control vector.
advisories.RUSTSEC-2026-0340: Fixed by the fork's port of quinn #2868, and unreachable: the server leaves ack_frequency_config unset.
advisories.RUSTSEC-2026-0341: Not affected: every reassembly fragment's allocation is charged to the fork's receive budget, and gaps of a stream read out of order are capped by the fork commit "Cap the gaps of a stream read out of order".
advisories.RUSTSEC-2026-0342: Fixed upstream in noq 1.4.0, whose DatagramBuffer counts each entry in both directions; received datagrams also charge their own budget, by the fork commit "Charge received datagrams to a budget of their own".
advisories.RUSTSEC-2026-0343: Not affected: DatagramBuffer subtracts an evicted datagram once, in pop_front.

commits.subject: feat: reset_stream_at TransportParameter
commits.purpose: Adds the reset_stream_at transport parameter and its endpoint option and 0-RTT compatibility check.

commits.subject: Add the frame type itself
commits.purpose: Adds the RESET_STREAM_AT frame type, codec, qlog and statistics.

commits.subject: impl retransmit of RESET_STREAM_AT
commits.purpose: Tracks RESET_STREAM_AT for retransmission.

commits.subject: allow sending the RESET_STREAM_AT
commits.purpose: Adds SendStream::reset_at, truncating send data beyond the reliable size.

commits.subject: wip: thanks to claude
commits.purpose: Completes reliable reset receive handling, flow control, acknowledgement tracking and peer-support gating, with tests.

commits.subject: noq-proto: release reset receive credit exactly once
commits.purpose: Returns RESET_STREAM_AT credit through upstream's take_unread_credit (#842), the one owner of credit for unread data; unordered reads track delivered ranges, so a consumed tail neither counts as the reliable prefix nor earns credit twice.

commits.subject: noq-proto: advertise reset_stream_at on 0x1d and the draft codepoint
commits.purpose: Advertises and accepts the IETF 0x1d and the deployed draft codepoint; rejects duplicates and nonempty values.

commits.subject: noq-proto: compute the Retry integrity tag with ring or aws-lc-rs
commits.purpose: Computes the Retry tag with the rustls crypto provider instead of RustCrypto aes-gcm, with the RFC 9001 vector.

commits.subject: Test the Graphite Meter fork
commits.purpose: Adds the fork-only CI workflow for graphite-meter branches.

commits.subject: Bound datagram queue storage and detach packet backing
commits.purpose: Copies queued datagram payloads so they cannot pin packet buffers, and counts the new entry against upstream's DatagramBuffer send window.

commits.subject: Bound queued incoming packet storage
commits.purpose: Charges queued incoming packets by capacity, caps each connection's queue and copies each datagram and GSO segment apart instead of slicing upstream's shared batch buffer, so a packet pins only its own bytes.

commits.subject: Expose connection lifetime and buffered stream payload
commits.purpose: Exposes buffered send bytes and a weak handle while connecting for external memory accounting.

commits.subject: Bound receive reassembly metadata and copy backing
commits.purpose: Charges reassembly metadata to a per-connection budget, copies fragments into bounded blocks and closes on exhaustion. The budget replaces upstream's MAX_CHUNKS cap, which counts packets rather than gaps and closes a stream with 2,048 packets behind one loss; the binary heap stays, since a sorted VecDeque inserts in O(n) without that cap.

commits.subject: Charge receive backing through delivered byte ownership
commits.purpose: Keeps received STREAM data charged until the application drops the delivered bytes.

commits.subject: Expose receive allocation lifetime on weak connection handles
commits.purpose: Lets the owner see when a closed connection's received bytes are freed.

commits.subject: Bound retained stream send storage
commits.purpose: Copies send writes into budget-charged backing and charges acknowledgement and retransmit range sets.

commits.subject: Retransmit without allocating range metadata
commits.purpose: Retransmits the whole unacknowledged span when range metadata cannot be charged.

commits.subject: Precharge sparse stream acknowledgement storage
commits.purpose: Tracks stream acknowledgements in a bitmap charged at write time so sparse ACKs never allocate.

commits.subject: Refund only newly acknowledged stream bytes
commits.purpose: Stops duplicate or overlapping ACKs from reducing unacknowledged data twice.

commits.subject: Bound packet index ownership without sequence gaps
commits.purpose: Replaces the sent-packet index with a charged map; under pressure sends only untracked ACK packets.

commits.subject: Bound retained datagram storage through its last owner
commits.purpose: Charges DatagramBuffer's queue capacity and each copied payload until the last owner drops them, beside upstream's window accounting.

commits.subject: Block untracked packet padding and abandoned path retries
commits.purpose: Stops budget-starved untracked packets from being padded or abandoning the path.

commits.subject: Retain exact CRYPTO backing allocation credit
commits.purpose: Charges outgoing handshake CRYPTO data and closes when it cannot be charged.

commits.subject: Bound retained packet control storage
commits.purpose: Charges queued control-frame retransmit state and closes with INTERNAL_ERROR on exhaustion; upstream's bounded retire_cids queues through the charged control vector.

commits.subject: Retain normalized close reason backing
commits.purpose: Copies CONNECTION_CLOSE reasons into charged backing so they cannot pin packet buffers.

commits.subject: Bound stream state through final acknowledgment
commits.purpose: Charges stream map entries, pending lists and events until final acknowledgment; opening fails when exhausted.

commits.subject: Keep reassembly room for receive credit already granted
commits.purpose: Keeps the reassembly cap at three windows plus unpaid shrink debt so lowering the receive window cannot fail a peer using granted credit.

commits.subject: Charge connection buffers to a shared budget
commits.purpose: Charges every per-connection pool and the runtime packet queue to a process-wide SharedBudget while bytes are buffered; a refusal closes only that connection.

commits.subject: Probe with an untracked PING under packet metadata pressure
commits.purpose: Sends a PTO probe as an untracked PING when metadata is exhausted so the ACK that frees metadata can still arrive.

commits.subject: Stop pressure tests only when the application cannot progress
commits.purpose: Test-only: ends pressure loops when a retried write makes no progress and makes the MTU padding test deterministic.

commits.subject: Precharge pending MAX_STREAM_DATA with receive stream state
commits.purpose: Reserves each receive stream's pending credit entry at stream creation so reading and granting credit never allocate under packet pressure.

commits.subject: Lint all features in the fork workflow
commits.purpose: Fixes the bench module import and lints all features in fork CI, matching upstream.

commits.subject: Own reset and stop frames with their stream state
commits.purpose: Keeps RESET_STREAM(_AT) and STOP_SENDING as latest-wins stream state precharged per stream, so application stop and reset never fail the connection under packet pressure.

commits.subject: Send due ACKs while the congestion window is full
commits.purpose: Sends an untracked ACK-only packet when congestion-blocked with ACKs due (RFC 9002 §7, RFC 9000 §13.2.1); CONNECTION_CLOSE stays exempt from the congestion check, as upstream's close-while-blocked test checks.

commits.subject: Sample RTT only when the largest acknowledged packet is tracked
commits.purpose: Stops untracked probes from inflating RTT with a stale send time.

commits.subject: Pay receive window shrink debt before growing credit
commits.purpose: Grows peer credit only after paying earlier shrink debt, so shrink and grow cycles cannot stack MAX_DATA.

commits.subject: Drop the reset control entry once RESET_STREAM_AT is acknowledged
commits.purpose: Removes a stale reset entry at acknowledgement so no empty packet is built.

commits.subject: Send congestion-blocked ACKs alone
commits.purpose: Keeps PING and other frames off the untracked ACK-only path and ends the batch after it.

commits.subject: Restart PTO backoff from untracked probes
commits.purpose: Re-arms loss detection and backoff from untracked probes (RFC 9002 doubling); probes are not counted in flight.

commits.subject: Keep send times of recent untracked packets
commits.purpose: Keeps a fixed ring of recent untracked send times so ECN and RTT use real send times.

commits.subject: Assert the mechanism each metadata pressure test covers
commits.purpose: Test-only: pressure tests assert the mechanism they cover.

commits.subject: Precharge a per-connection buffer floor
commits.purpose: Charges a per-pool reserve at connection creation; shared-budget refusals degrade instead of closing healthy connections.

commits.subject: Precharge the state of every stream the peer may open
commits.purpose: Precharges stream state for every stream the peer may open, exposed as TransportConfig::connection_floor_bytes().

commits.subject: Benchmark send buffer lookups behind 16 KiB segments
commits.purpose: Bench-only: measures segment lookup and streaming transfer at 1 MiB and 48 MiB in flight.

commits.subject: Look up send buffer segments by binary search
commits.purpose: Replaces the per-frame linear scan of unacknowledged segments with an offset index (upstreamable; quinn has the same scan).

commits.subject: Find ranges overlapping a query by binary search
commits.purpose: Makes ArrayRangeSet overlap queries O(log n + k).

commits.subject: Track acknowledged send data as ranges instead of a bitmap
commits.purpose: Replaces the per-byte ACK bitmap with charged ranges; a refused gap ACK degrades to retransmission and never closes the connection.

commits.subject: Resend a lost FIN that carried no data
commits.purpose: Keeps a lost FIN-only STREAM frame queued for retransmission (fixes a stall introduced with noq#805).

commits.subject: Keep leased send chunks uncopied until acknowledged
commits.purpose: Adds write_leased_chunks: a stream keeps the Bytes it is handed instead of copying them into 16 KiB blocks, charged by length like a copied block until the segment is released.

commits.subject: Drain old lost-packet records when packet tracking is exhausted
commits.purpose: Retires lost-packet records older than two PTOs when tracking cannot reserve a packet, then retries once to restore send progress.

commits.subject: Batch up to 32 datagrams per QUIC transmit
commits.purpose: Bounds GSO batches at 32 datagrams and each drive at 64 before yielding to receive work.

commits.subject: Reuse bounded receive metadata and account copied backing accurately
commits.purpose: Reuses at most four fully charged reassembly metadata slots, releases larger drained heaps, and bases compaction on copied backing plus owner allocation instead of discarded packet storage; retains lifetime and tiny-fragment budget tests.

commits.subject: Make receive compaction coverage independent of pointer width
commits.purpose: Derives the tiny-fragment compaction test threshold from the actual owner footprint on each architecture.

commits.subject: Preserve receive batches across cooperative packet-processing yields
commits.purpose: Preserves full socket and GRO batches across cooperative packet-processing yields, retains receive metadata and rebinding origin, keeps upstream's ECONNRESET and EMSGSIZE ignores, and covers interruption, migration and Smol-only builds.

commits.subject: Explicitly discard transmit metadata in the rebinding fixture
commits.purpose: Test-only: explicitly consumes the must-use transmit metadata while constructing the rebinding fixture.

commits.subject: Reuse receive metadata across cooperative endpoint turns
commits.purpose: Keeps received descriptors in stable endpoint storage and borrows each descriptor, avoiding repeated array initialization and moves without changing receive batches, cooperative checks or socket migration.

commits.subject: Size the endpoint receive batch to four GRO messages
commits.purpose: Holds four GRO messages per endpoint receive batch instead of 32, which still exceeds one cooperative turn, and exposes receive_batch_bytes for owner accounting.

commits.subject: Autotune the connection receive window
commits.purpose: Adds TransportConfig::initial_receive_window: the connection window starts there and doubles up to receive_window while half of it is read within two round trips, as in quic-go.

commits.subject: Gate the Graphite Meter fork on Rust 1.99.0
commits.purpose: Runs the fork workflow on Rust 1.99.0 and allows the fetch_update deprecation the older MSRV requires.

commits.subject: Wake connection-blocked streams longest waiting first
commits.purpose: Wakes streams blocked on connection credit in the order they blocked, so a writer that takes every grant cannot starve the other streams on a slow or lossy path.

commits.subject: State the wake order the connection credit queue relies on
commits.purpose: Documents that the longest-waiting order holds when woken tasks run in wake order, as on a current-thread runtime.

commits.subject: congestion: avoid double-reducing CUBIC ssthresh on persistent congestion
commits.purpose: Reduces ssthresh once on persistent congestion, as RFC 9438 requires.

commits.subject: proto: reject Initial tokens that prevent packet construction
commits.purpose: Closes the connection when a Retry or cached token leaves an Initial no room for frames, instead of panicking or allocating without bound (GHSA-wppq); TransmitBuf gains truncate.

commits.subject: proto: reserve close frame space after large Initial headers
commits.purpose: Limits a close packet's ACKs so its CONNECTION_CLOSE always fits after a large Initial token.

commits.subject: Keep large received stream frames in their packet's buffer
commits.purpose: Keeps a STREAM frame filling at least half its packet in the packet's buffer, charged at the packet's size; smaller frames are still copied into their own charged backing.

commits.subject: Charge the shared budget in steps above the floor
commits.purpose: Charges the shared budget in 64 KiB steps above a budget's floor, keeping at most two unused steps and none at or below the floor.

commits.subject: proto: take an RTT sample from a Retry
commits.purpose: Takes a round-trip sample from a Retry that answers the unrepeated first Initial, so the resent ClientHello is not paced at the 333 ms initial RTT (upstreamable; quic-go does the same).

commits.subject: proto: follow RFC 9438 for Cubic's Reno-friendly estimate and K
commits.purpose: Restarts Cubic's Reno-friendly estimate at the reduced window and grows it per window acknowledged, switching alpha_cubic to 1 at the window before the reduction, and takes K from W_max minus the reduced window, as RFC 9438 Sections 4.2 and 4.3 do (upstreamable; Linux and quic-go's Cubic do the same).

commits.subject: Test that a receive EMSGSIZE keeps the endpoint alive
commits.purpose: Test-only: feeds the split receive loop a real EMSGSIZE from an oversized send; the ignore itself is upstream's.
commits.origin: graphite-meter, from the fork's port of n0-computer/noq#823 c3cac8afa73f86994bf7372929fe12d48fe2b07e

commits.subject: proto: reject transport parameters with a mismatched length
commits.purpose: Rejects a transport parameter whose value does not fill its declared length, so no parameter can be smuggled inside another.

commits.subject: proto: accept nonminimal integer transport parameters
commits.purpose: Accepts integer transport parameters that are not minimally encoded, as RFC 9000 §16 allows.

commits.subject: Reject Retry packets bearing a SCID that matches the initial DCID
commits.purpose: Discards a Retry whose source CID equals the client's first destination CID, as RFC 9000 §17.2.5.2 requires.

commits.subject: proto: avoid panic on high minimum ACK delay
commits.purpose: Lets a peer's min_ack_delay above the RTT bound win instead of panicking in clamp when choosing the ACK frequency max_ack_delay.

commits.subject: proto: make the min_ack_delay length test need the length check
commits.purpose: Gives the min_ack_delay length test bytes that only the post-match length check rejects.

commits.subject: udp: handle receive errors before truncation flags
commits.purpose: Stops recv_single spinning when MSG_TRUNC stays set from a previous datagram and the socket then returns EAGAIN.

commits.subject: proto: keep close reason on stateless reset once draining
commits.purpose: Keeps the peer's close reason when a stateless reset ends draining, instead of reporting Reset or a second ConnectionLost.

commits.subject: fix: potential CID leak in connect()
commits.purpose: Releases the local CID when TLS refuses a connect, so it no longer routes to a reused connection handle.

commits.subject: proto: report a stopped stream to a write blocked by connection credit
commits.purpose: Checks a stream's STOP_SENDING before connection flow control, so a writer waiting for credit learns of the stop; Chrome grants no credit back until the reset that follows.

commits.subject: Take the fork's imports from core and alloc
commits.purpose: Takes the fork's imports from core and alloc, which noq-proto's no_std lints require since n0-computer/noq#838.

commits.subject: Run upstream's reassembly tests against the heap assembler
commits.purpose: Test-only: runs upstream's random, partial-overlap and mixed-defragmentation assembler tests on the heap assembler and checks that 4,096 packets behind one loss are buffered.

commits.subject: Copy coalesced packets apart
commits.purpose: Gives each packet of a coalesced datagram its own allocation, so a frame kept in its packet's buffer pins only that packet.

commits.subject: Charge received datagrams to a budget of their own
commits.purpose: Charges received datagrams to their own floorless budget of four datagram windows, so they cannot take reassembly room that granted stream credit needs; a refused charge drops the datagram.

commits.subject: Cap the gaps of a stream read out of order
commits.purpose: Closes a stream read out of order once it holds more than 1,024 received ranges, bounding the O(n) range-set inserts.

commits.subject: Tune the receive window from application reads only
commits.purpose: Feeds receive window autotuning only from application reads, not from credit returned for stopped or reset streams.

commits.subject: Forget unacknowledged stream data when 0-RTT is rejected
commits.purpose: Resets unacked_data when 0-RTT is rejected, so send_buffered_bytes and the write limit recover (upstreamable).

commits.subject: Change a budget's shared charge under a lock
commits.purpose: Reads a budget's use and changes its shared charge under one lock, so a release cannot trim below a racing acquire.

commits.subject: Buffer nothing past a reliable reset's size
commits.purpose: Drops data past a RESET_STREAM_AT reliable size on arrival, since it is never delivered and its credit was already returned.

commits.subject: Take a budget's charge lock only when the charge must move
commits.purpose: Checks a budget's charge before taking its lock, and restores a trimmed charge when an acquire raced past the trim, so uncontended acquires and releases stay lock-free.

commits.subject: Charge a floorless budget's shared bytes in small steps
commits.purpose: Charges a floorless budget's shared bytes in 4 KiB steps, so a held datagram does not hold a 64 KiB step of the shared budget.

commits.subject: Drop data buffered past a reliable reset's size
commits.purpose: Drops data buffered past the reliable size when a RESET_STREAM_AT arrives or lowers it.

advisories.RUSTSEC-2024-0003: Patched in h2 0.4.2, before the fork's base v0.4.20.

advisories.RUSTSEC-2026-0258: Patched in h2 0.4.16, before the fork's base v0.4.20.

commits.subject: Bound buffered receive events and backing storage
commits.purpose: Charges each buffered DATA event and copies payloads and pseudo-headers so they cannot pin read buffers.

commits.subject: Bound queued send metadata and codec storage
commits.purpose: Caps queued DATA frames per stream and stops the codec write buffer growing past its default capacity.

commits.subject: Fix upstream strict lint and test cleanup
commits.purpose: Fixes strict Clippy findings and moves the fork's wire test into h2-tests.

commits.subject: Preserve client concurrency and refund discarded requests
commits.purpose: Limits drain accounting to servers and refunds DATA of discarded pending-accept streams.

commits.subject: Add strict owner fork gates
commits.purpose: Adds the fork-only CI workflow running fmt, strict Clippy and tests.

commits.subject: Refund in-flight DATA when the codec is dropped
commits.purpose: Refunds a pending DATA frame and releases its stream when the connection is dropped.

commits.subject: Bound retained header map metadata
commits.purpose: Caps header map capacity by the header list limit and resets streams with oversized trailers.

commits.subject: Release idle receive and send slab capacity
commits.purpose: Shrinks idle stream slab capacity so a burst of streams does not pin memory after it ends.

commits.subject: Charge connection state and receive window to a shared budget
commits.purpose: Charges header, event and queued metadata state against a per-connection allowance and funds connection receive-window growth from a SharedBudget; refusals stay stream-local.

commits.subject: Refuse requests the state allowance cannot hold as retryable
commits.purpose: Answers allowance refusals of request headers with RST_STREAM(REFUSED_STREAM) and no response, keeps HPACK in sync, keeps 431 for genuinely oversize lists and uses ENHANCE_YOUR_CALM for refused trailers.

commits.subject: Refund receive window credit when the connection ends
commits.purpose: Refunds charged receive credit on EOF, drop and connection error even while handlers hold stream handles.

commits.subject: Exempt empty final DATA from the send allowance
commits.purpose: Lets a response finish with an empty END_STREAM frame under allowance pressure.

commits.subject: Restore is_released's doc comment
commits.purpose: Moves a misplaced doc comment back to its function.

commits.subject: Gate the Graphite Meter fork on Rust 1.99.0
commits.purpose: Runs the fork workflow on Rust 1.99.0 and allows the fetch_update deprecation the older MSRV requires.

commits.subject: Refresh large receive windows once a mebibyte is unclaimed
commits.purpose: Caps the WINDOW_UPDATE threshold at 1 MiB so a large receive window stays nearly full over a long path, as Go refreshes after 4 KiB.

commits.subject: Scale the large-window refresh with the window
commits.purpose: Refreshes a window once a sixteenth of it, at least 1 MiB, is unclaimed, so a 64 MiB window does not send an update per mebibyte.

commits.subject: fix: preserve received END_STREAM on connection error and EOF (#977)
commits.purpose: Keeps a received END_STREAM when the connection errors, sends GOAWAY or reaches EOF.

commits.subject: Hold v0.4.20's code to the fork's strict lints
commits.purpose: Moves recv.rs's impls back before its tests and asserts with assert! in v0.4.20's code.
